impact: Keeps pressure on the AI chip chain into the US open, a headwind for MU, DRAM and SNXX; NBIS reports before the open, which could steer neocloud sentiment either way.
summary: Nvidia was down about 6% to 7% in US premarket trading and about 7% in Frankfurt on Thursday, with no board decision announced after Wednesday's meeting on CEO Jensen Huang's future. Alibaba fell about 7% on worries about access to Nvidia chips, while AMD gained about 3.9% and Broadcom about 3%. US and European chip stocks dipped.
title: Nvidia ~-7% premarket as board weighs Huang; Alibaba falls 7%
